clue.text: A considerable amount of pain evident in Les Misérables?

definitions.text: A considerable amount of pain evident in Les Misérables?

explanation.surface: Much suffering on show in the tragic musical.
explanation.walkthrough: The French title signals reading 'pain' as French bread, so a considerable amount of it is several long loaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Long thin French loaves of bread are the bread of the French setting.

clue.text: Spiritual figure exhibiting a small switch in opinion

clue.text: Expression of surprise when filling a recording agreement

clue.text: Restrict transport for opposition?

explanation.surface: Limiting transport available to the opposition party.

explanation.definitionFit: To constrain is to restrict or hold back.

clue.text: Great to bring in trap involving attraction

parts.note: magic is slang for great or wonderful

clue.text: Difficulty with ship entering sound
